sources.title: Testing and interpreting measures of ovarian reserve: a committee opinion
sources.claim: Evidence of DOR does not necessarily equate with inability to conceive; ovarian reserve markers should not be used to deny access to treatment; they are good predictors of egg yield; antral follicles are 2-10 mm.
sources.quote: Evidence of DOR does not necessarily equate with inability to conceive ... they should not be used as a fertility test or to deny access to infertility treatment

sources.title: Fresh and cumulative live birth rates in mild versus conventional stimulation for IVF cycles in poor ovarian responders: a systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.claim: 15 RCTs in poor responders: mild stimulation gave comparable fresh live birth (RR 1.01) and cumulative live birth to conventional stimulation, with slightly fewer eggs and more cancellations (RR 1.48).
sources.quote: Mild ovarian stimulation (MOS) results in comparable outcomes to those of conventional stimulation ... FLBR RR 1.01 (95% CI 0.97-1.04)

sources.title: Pretreatment with coenzyme Q10 improves ovarian response and embryo quality in low-prognosis young women with decreased ovarian reserve: a randomized controlled trial
sources.claim: 186 women under 35 with poor ovarian reserve; 60 days of CoQ10 before IVF gave more eggs (median 4 vs 2) and more high-quality embryos; pregnancy and live birth tended to be higher but not significantly.
sources.quote: 186 women randomised ... CoQ10 for 60 days ... oocytes retrieved 4 (IQR 2-5) vs 2 (1-2) ... clinical pregnancy and live birth rates tended to be higher but not statistically significant

sources.title: Androgens (dehydroepiandrosterone or testosterone) for women undergoing assisted reproduction
sources.claim: DHEA pretreatment associated with higher live birth (8 RCTs, 878 women): if 12% with placebo, about 15% to 26% with DHEA; moderate-quality evidence; effect not significant once high-bias trials removed; benefit in women with prior treatment (mostly poor responders).
sources.quote: If the chance of live birth with placebo is 12%, the chance with DHEA would be between 15% and 26% ... moderate quality

sources.title: Cumulative live birth rates and number of oocytes retrieved in women of advanced age. A single centre analysis including 4500 women >=38 years old
sources.claim: 4,570 women 38+: more eggs per retrieval means higher cumulative live birth; at 40-41, about 24% with 12 eggs vs about 12% with 4 eggs; benefit largest up to 41.
sources.quote: a higher number of oocytes is associated with a higher CLBR ... For 12 oocytes about 24% (40-41); for 4 oocytes about 12%

sources.title: The live birth rate of vitrified oocyte accumulation for managing diminished ovarian reserve: a retrospective cohort study
sources.claim: 440 women with DOR (AMH below 1.2 ng/ml or AFC below 5): banking frozen eggs gave cumulative live birth 20.4% vs 27.5% with fresh cycles (not significant) and more miscarriage; with 15 or more banked eggs, live birth per transfer was 29.0%.
sources.quote: Cumulative LBR per intention to treat 20.4% vs 27.5%, p = 0.081 ... vitrified oocyte accumulation did not improve LBR

sources.title: Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) treatment of the ovaries significantly improves fertility parameters and reproductive outcomes in diminished ovarian reserve patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.claim: 38 human studies: after ovarian PRP, AMH up 0.36 ng/ml at 3 months, AFC up 1.60 follicles; pooled live birth 11% (177 of 1,482); spontaneous pregnancy 7%; evidence mostly low quality (observational).
sources.quote: AMH increased 0.36 ng/ml at 3 months ... AFC increased by 1.60 ... live birth 0.11 (177/1,482) ... spontaneous pregnancy 0.07

sources.title: First live births after adipose-derived stem cells and platelet-rich plasma intraovarian administration
sources.claim: A 46-year-old with DOR (AMH 0.29, AFC 2) had AFC 14 six months after adipose-PRP, conceived naturally and delivered at 47; a 45-year-old had 4 mature eggs and 2 blastocysts (1 euploid) three months after treatment, leading to a birth.
sources.quote: Case 1, a 46-year-old with diminished ovarian reserve ... AFC increased to 14 ... conceived naturally ... delivered a healthy infant at age 47

sources.title: Egg donation (fact sheet)
sources.claim: 53.5% average birth rate per embryo transfer with fresh donor eggs (2020 SART/CDC); donors usually 21-34.
sources.quote: an average birth rate per embryo transfer of 53.5% for all egg donor programs using fresh eggs
